g.text: These two characters contain all 75 coordinate cubes. The pictures show complete blocks; the searches processed only prefixes.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: The μ₆ grading is equivariant: β and A have character 3. Block sizes and ranks do not count geometric solutions.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: Display bins: quadrics 6 rows × 1 column; cubic blocks 20 × 8. A bin is filled iff it contains an exact nonzero coefficient.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b94d42

g.text: The exact exclusions use rational polynomial identities, not the density, shape, or modular rank of these pictures.
